messages:
incident-bot: PAGER → High 5xx rate observed for org MapleWave (org_98421). Error rate 12% over 5m, request queue length rising on pool-eus1. Paging oncall. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/98421 :rotating_light:

jordan-oncall: Ack. jumping in — looking at traces and queue sizes now.

sam-sre: Seeing KV cache pressure and GPU mem spikes on nodes serving MapleWave. Request latency tail > 3s, dropping tokens. Could be long-seq runs + large batching.

ina-pm: MapleWave just flipped an A/B test hitting prod with long-form summarization + high conc. They reported slow responses.

rob-acct: Customer called support, reported "time outs and 500s". They said it's blocking production traffic.

jordan-oncall: Candidate mitigations: 1) targeted org-level rate limit bump (increase qps temporarily), 2) restrict long-sequence model variants or disable batch-heavy route, 3) add token cap per request. Thoughts?

sam-sre: Prefer targeted RL bump + disable their long-seq route. Bump reduces queue drain pressure quickly.

lee-infra: I can flip a feature-gate on their org and apply org RL. Proposed command: ```rctl rl set-org --org 98421 --qps 60 --burst 120 --window 60 --note "emergency bump 2026-03-17"```

maya-eng: If we bump, recommend also enforcing max_tokens=1024 server-side for their requests to avoid runaway token cost. I can add a short override on the routing layer: ```/cfg/overrides/org_98421.json -> {"max_tokens":1024, "allow_long_seq":false}```

jordan-oncall: Do it. Apply RL bump + disable long-seq route. Schedule auto-revert in 30m, monitor.

lee-infra: Applying RL now.```> rctl rl set-org --org 98421 --qps 60 --burst 120 --window 60 --actor lee-infra --change-id 20260317-rl1```

ops-bot: rl-change accepted: change-id=20260317-rl1, org=98421, new_qps=60, burst=120, applied_by=lee-infra at 2026-03-17T14:02:12Z

jordan-oncall: Disabling long-seq route for org 98421 now.```> rctl route toggle --org 98421 --route long-seq --state off --actor jordan-oncall```

ops-bot: route-toggle accepted: org=98421 route=long-seq state=off actor=jordan-oncall at 2026-03-17T14:03:05Z

sam-sre: Metrics after actions: queue length dropping, p50 latency down ~200ms, 5xx rate fell to 3% within 4m. GPU mem stabilized on pool-eus1.

rob-acct: Relay to customer that we applied a temporary rate adjustment + disabled the long-seq path; recommend they reduce concurrent batch sizes.

ina-pm: I'll message their PM and ask them to pause the A/B test while we validate. Also capture if their feature rollout triggered it.

jordan-oncall: Setting automated rollback at +30m unless we extend. If still high, we'll escalate to reserved capacity or model fallback.

maya-eng: Adding a short-term regen policy: enforce per-request token cap and reject >1024 with 429 + guidance message.

ops-bot: monitor-note: watch: org_98421. 5xx<5% ; queue_len<30 ; gpu_mem<85% ; rollback_at=2026-03-17T14:32:12Z

sam-sre: Small note — we should add this org to a short blacklist for auto-batching heuristics so they don't get large batch windows again. I'll open an RFC.

rob-acct: Customer acknowledged workaround and muted immediate escalation. Thank you team. :thumbsup:

jordan-oncall: We'll keep the thread updated. Assigning follow-up to sam-sre and nina-pm for postmortem and customer comms.

ops-bot: rollback executed (auto): rl-change reverted change-id=20260317-rl1 at 2026-03-17T14:32:12Z; route long-seq state restored=on at 2026-03-17T14:32:18Z

sam-sre: Post-action metrics look stable. 5xx steady at 0.8%, p90 latency back to baseline. Captured traces for root-cause.

nina-pm: I'll draft a short incident note to send to the customer and internal incident tracker.

jordan-oncall: Closing pager. Will file postmortem with timeline + recommended config guardrails. Great teamwork. :pray:
